text_en: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat beside the sea.
text_cn: 在那一天，耶稣从家里出来，坐在海边上，

text_en: Such great crowds gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat there, while the whole crowd stood on the beach.
text_cn: 有许多群众集合到他跟前，他只得上船坐下，群众都站在岸上。

text_en: And he told them many things in parables, saying: “Listen! A sower went out to sow.
text_cn: 他就用比喻给他们讲论了许多事说： “看，有个撒种的出去撒种；

text_en: And as he sowed, some seeds fell on the path, and the birds came and ate them up.
text_cn: 他撒种的时候，有的落在路旁，飞鸟来把它吃了。

text_en: Other seeds fell on rocky ground, where they did not have much soil, and they sprang up quickly, since they had no depth of soil.
text_cn: 有的落在石头地里，那里没有多少土壤，因为所有的土壤不深，即刻发了芽；

text_en: But when the sun rose, they were scorched; and since they had no root, they withered away.
text_cn: 但太阳一出来，就被晒焦；又因为没有根，就枯干了。

text_en: Other seeds fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them.
text_cn: 有的落在荆棘中，荆棘长起来，便把它们窒息了。

text_en: Other seeds fell on good soil and brought forth grain, some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
text_cn: 有的落在好地里，就结了实：有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。

text_en: Let anyone with ears listen! ”
text_cn: 有耳的，听吧！”

text_en: Then the disciples came and asked him, “Why do you speak to them in parables? ”
text_cn: 门徒们前来对他说：“为什么你用比喻对他们讲话？”

text_en: He answered, “To you it has been given to know the secrets of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been given.
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“因为天国的奥妙，是给你们知道，并不是给他们知道。

text_en: For to those who have, more will be given, and they will have an abundance; but from those who have nothing, even what they have will be taken away.
text_cn: 因为凡有的，还要给他，使他富足；但是，凡没有的，连他所有的，也要由他夺去。

text_en: The reason I speak to them in parables is that ‘seeing they do not perceive, and hearing they do not listen, nor do they understand. ’
text_cn: 为此，我用比喻对他们讲话，是因为他们看，却看不见；听，却听不见，也不了解；

text_en: With them indeed is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah that says: ‘You will indeed listen, but never understand, and you will indeed look, but never perceive.
text_cn: 这样为他们正应验了依撒意亚的预言，说：‘你们听是听，但不了解；看是看，但不明白，

text_en: For this people’s heart has grown dull, and their ears are hard of hearing, and they have shut their eyes; so that they might not look with their eyes, and listen with their ears, and understand with their heart and turn— and I would heal them. ’
text_cn: 因为这百姓的心迟钝了，耳朵难以听见；他们闭了眼睛，免得眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里了解而转变，而要我医好他们。’

text_en: But blessed are your eyes, for they see, and your ears, for they hear.
text_cn: 但你们的眼睛有福，因为看得见；你们的耳朵有福，因为听得见。

text_en: Truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, but did not see it, and to hear what you hear, but did not hear it.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：有许多先知和义人，想看你们所看见的，而没有看到；想听你们所听见的，而没有听到。”

text_en: “Hear then the parable of the sower.
text_cn: “那么，你们听这撒种者的比喻吧！

text_en: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what is sown in the heart; this is what was sown on the path.
text_cn: 凡听天国的话，而不了解的，那恶者就来把撒在他心里的夺去：这是指那撒在路旁的。

text_en: As for what was sown on rocky ground, this is the one who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;
text_cn: 那撒在石头地里的，即是指人听了话，立刻高兴接受；

text_en: yet such a person has no root, but endures only for a while, and when trouble or persecution arises on account of the word, that person immediately falls away.
text_cn: 但在心里没有根，不能持久，一旦为这话发生了艰难和迫害，就立刻跌倒了。

text_en: As for what was sown among thorns, this is the one who hears the word, but the cares of the world and the lure of wealth choke the word, and it yields nothing.
text_cn: 那撒在荆棘中的，即是指人听了话，却有世俗的焦虑和财富的迷惑，把话蒙住了，结不出果实。

text_en: But as for what was sown on good soil, this is the one who hears the word and understands it, who indeed bears fruit and yields, in one case a hundredfold, in another sixty, and in another thirty. ”
text_cn: 那撒在好地里的，即是指那听了话而了解的人，他当然结实，有结一百倍的，有结六十倍的，有结三十倍的。”

text_en: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven may be compared to someone who sowed good seed in his field;
text_cn: 耶稣给他们另设了一个比喻说：“天国好像一个人，在自己田里撒了好种子；

text_en: but while everybody was asleep, an enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and then went away.
text_cn: 但在人睡觉的时候，他的仇人来，在麦子中间撒上莠子，就走了。

text_en: So when the plants came up and bore grain, then the weeds appeared as well.
text_cn: 苗长起来，抽出穗的时候，莠子也显出来了。

text_en: And the slaves of the householder came and said to him, ‘Master, did you not sow good seed in your field? Where, then, did these weeds come from? ’
text_cn: 家主的仆人，就前来对他说：主人！你不是在你田地里撒了好种子吗？那么从哪里来了莠子？

text_en: He answered, ‘An enemy has done this. ’ The slaves said to him, ‘Then do you want us to go and gather them? ’
text_cn: 家主对他们说：这是仇人做的。仆人对他说：那么，你愿我们去把莠子收集起来吗？

text_en: But he replied, ‘No; for in gathering the weeds you would uproot the wheat along with them.
text_cn: 他却说：不，免得你们收集莠子，连麦子也拔了出来。

text_en: Let both of them grow together until the harvest; and at harvest time I will tell the reapers, Collect the weeds first and bind them in bundles to be burned, but gather the wheat into my barn. ’”
text_cn: 让两样一起长到收割的时候好了；在收割时，我要对收割的人说：你们先收集莠子，把莠子捆成捆，好燃烧，把麦子却收入我的仓里。”

text_en: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that someone took and sowed in his field;
text_cn: 耶稣给他们另设一个比喻说：“天国好像一粒芥子，人把它撒在自己的田里。

text_en: it is the smallest of all the seeds, but when it has grown it is the greatest of shrubs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and make nests in its branches. ”
text_cn: 它固然是各样种子里最小的，但当它长起来，却比各种蔬菜都大，竟成了树，甚至天上的飞鸟飞来，在它的枝上栖息。”

text_en: He told them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed in with three measures of flour until all of it was leavened. ”
text_cn: 他又给他们讲了一个比喻：“天国好像酵母，女人取来藏在三斗面里，直到全部发了酵。”

text_en: Jesus told the crowds all these things in parables; without a parable he told them nothing.
text_cn: 耶稣用比喻给群众讲解了这一切，不用比喻就不给他们讲什么；

text_en: This was to fulfill what had been spoken through the prophet: “I will open my mouth to speak in parables; I will proclaim what has been hidden from the foundation of the world. ”
text_cn: 这样应验了先知所说的话：“我要开口说比喻，要说出由创世以来的隐密事。”

text_en: Then he left the crowds and went into the house. And his disciples approached him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds of the field. ”
text_cn: 那时，耶稣离开了群众，来到家里，他的门徒就前来对他说：“请把田间莠子的比喻给我们讲解一下！”

text_en: He answered, “The one who sows the good seed is the Son of Man;
text_cn: 他就回答说：“那撒好种子的，就是人子；

text_en: the field is the world, and the good seed are the children of the kingdom; the weeds are the children of the evil one,
text_cn: 田就是世界；好种子，即是天国的子民，莠子即是邪恶的子民；

text_en: and the enemy who sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
text_cn: 那撒莠子的仇人，即是魔鬼；收获时期，即是今世的终结；收割者即是天使。

text_en: Just as the weeds are collected and burned up with fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
text_cn: 就如将莠子收集起来，用火焚烧；在今世终结时也将是如此：

text_en: The Son of Man will send his angels, and they will collect out of his kingdom all causes of sin and all evildoers,
text_cn: 人子要差遣他的天使，由他的国内，将一切使人跌倒的事，及作恶的人收集起来，

text_en: and they will throw them into the furnace of fire, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_cn: 扔到火窑里；在那里要有哀号和切齿。

text_en: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Let anyone with ears listen!
text_cn: 那时，义人要在他们父的国里，发光如同太阳。有耳的，听吧！”

text_en: “The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field, which someone found and hid; then in his joy he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
text_cn: “天国好像是藏在地里的宝贝；人找到了，就把它藏起来，高兴地去卖掉他所有的一切，买了那块地。”

text_en: “Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls;
text_cn: “天国又好像一个寻找完美珍珠的商人；

text_en: on finding one pearl of great value, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
text_cn: 他一找到一颗宝贵的珍珠，就去，卖掉他所有的一切，买了它。”

text_en: “Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was thrown into the sea and caught fish of every kind;
text_cn: “天国又好像撒在海里的网，网罗各种的鱼。

text_en: when it was full, they drew it ashore, sat down, and put the good into baskets but threw out the bad.
text_cn: 网一满了，人就拉上岸来，坐下，拣好的，放在器皿里；坏的，扔在外面。

text_en: So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come out and separate the evil from the righteous
text_cn: 在今世的终结时，也将如此：天使要出去，把恶人由义人中分开，

text_en: and throw them into the furnace of fire, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_cn: 把他们扔在火窑里；在那里要有哀号和切齿。

text_en: “Have you understood all this? ” They answered, “Yes. ”
text_cn: 这一切你们都明白了吗？”他们说：“是的。”

text_en: And he said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been trained for the kingdom of heaven is like the master of a household who brings out of his treasure what is new and what is old. ”
text_cn: 他就对他们说：“为此，凡成为天国门徒的经师，就好像一个家主，从他的宝库里，提出新的和旧的东西。”

text_en: When Jesus had finished these parables, he left that place.
text_cn: 耶稣讲完了这些比喻，就从那里走了。

text_en: He came to his hometown and began to teach the people in their synagogue, so that they were astounded and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these deeds of power?
text_cn: 他来到自己的家乡，在会堂里教训人，以致人们都惊讶说：“这人从哪里得了这样的智慧和奇能？

text_en: Is not this the carpenter’s son? Is not his mother called Mary? And are not his brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?
text_cn: 这人不是那木匠的儿子？他的母亲不是叫玛利亚，他的弟兄不是叫雅各伯、若瑟、西满和犹达吗？

text_en: And are not all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all this? ”
text_cn: 他的姊妹不是都在我们这里吗？那么他的这一切是从哪里来的呢？”

text_en: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, “Prophets are not without honor except in their own country and in their own house. ”
text_cn: 他们就对他起了反感。 耶稣却对他们说：“先知除了在自己的本乡本家外，没有不受尊敬的。”

text_en: And he did not do many deeds of power there, because of their unbelief.
text_cn: 他在那里，因为他们不信，没有多行奇能。
